text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, the moon is beautiful tonight! ♪
It's perfect
for practicing magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Those clouds are blocking the
moon!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo! How am I supposed to
know if the
magic worked or not?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh! I'm not moving one inch until the

moonlight comes back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find out later that Sweep Tosho ended
up
missing curfew and staying out all
night.
